Before I finalize the plan, I need each of you to update the change ticket with your respective findings so they're formally recorded for the weekly change-control review. Once that's done, I'll set a concrete retirement date that accounts for all three constraints — the capacity commitment end date, the 14-day dual-write window, and the audit storage requirements. Does anyone see any additional conflicts between these constraints, or are we aligned on next steps?
